summary: Former tower on Narraguinnep Mountain, Dolores County, San Juan NF; registered 2009 as US 538 and taken down. No build, staffing or site details in sources.

facts.status_note: Taken down; no source describes what remains at the site.

evidence.supports: register entry says the tower has been taken down
evidence.quote: This tower has been taken down.

evidence.supports: in the San Juan National Forest

notes_for_editor: Three sources agree the tower is gone; none gives a build year, design, staffing or fire history, and none describes the site today. Do not link the August 2009 Narraguinnep Fire to this tower: the Benchmark Fire Lookout (a different tower, westlookouts.weebly.com/benchmark.html) is the one reported evacuated. The record's photo file name hints at June 1940, but the register page gives no caption, so it was not used. Public access unknown.
